theater: 奧龍特斯河谷與阿穆魯

battle.name: 第六次敘利亞戰役
battle.theater: 奧龍特斯河谷與阿穆魯
battle.brief: 前1449年，新王國法老圖特摩斯三世第六度北征，把戰線自迦南推入奧龍特斯河谷與阿穆魯地界，圍攻受米坦尼庇護的城邑，並重演佯退誘敵出城的城郊交戰。埃及步兵以長矛列陣封住退路，弓手壓制城頭，戰車迂迴分割敵陣；戰後米坦尼退守兩河，埃及取得阿穆魯宗主權，並開啟往後的敘利亞戰役。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 交戰兩方是埃及新王國第十八王朝與以胡里人為核心的米坦尼聯盟。埃及方面由法老圖特摩斯三世親任全軍主帥，軍隊骨架是步兵與弓手：中央是持長矛與圓盾的重裝步兵，兩翼與前鋒是數量最多的埃及弓手，另有數百輛雙輪戰車留作突擊與追擊，輔助兵力有來自努比亞的弓手、麥傑人與西部沙漠部族，以及被征服的黎凡特行省徵召兵。埃及最高行政樞紐設在孟斐斯，總理大臣賈胡提與國王之弟、大軍先鋒主將圖特摩斯在行軍中分管糧秣與開路。對面是胡里王國米坦尼，國王自稱大王，以宗主身分控制阿穆魯、卡脫納、圖尼普、阿勒頗、比布魯斯與西頓，並在幼發拉底河中游握有卡爾凱美什與埃馬爾等關隘城市；聯軍以步兵、輕裝矛兵、車兵與胡里弓手為骨幹。安納托利亞的赫梯此時已在高原集結準備南下，巴比倫則以青金石與馬匹輸給米坦尼，這條物資線正是雙方爭端的關鍵。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were Egypt of the Eighteenth Dynasty and the Mitanni coalition built on Hurrian power. On the Egyptian side the pharaoh Thutmose III commanded the whole host in person. The framework of the army was infantry and archery: in the centre, heavy foot armed with long spears and round shields; on the wings and in the vanguard, the largest contingent in the army, the Egyptian archers; and several hundred two-wheeled chariots held back for breakthrough and pursuit. Auxiliaries included Nubian archers, Medjay and western desert tribes, and conscripted levies from the conquered Levantine provinces. The Egyptian administrative centre sat at Memphis, while the vizier Djehuty and the king's brother, who led the vanguard of the same host, handled rations and the opening of the road on the march. Opposite them stood the Hurrian kingdom of Mitanni, whose king called himself the Great King and who, as overlord, held Amurru, Qatna, Tunip, Aleppo, Byblos and Sidon, and controlled Carchemish and Emar on the middle Euphrates; the coalition fought with infantry, light spear troops, chariot troops and Hurrian archers. Hatti in Anatolia was by then mustering on the plateau for a move south, while Babylonia fed Mitanni with lapis lazuli and horses, and control of that supply line lay at the heart of the quarrel.
people: 核心人物是年輕的法老圖特摩斯三世。他在前1479年即位時還很年輕，初期由攝政的哈特謝普蘇特主持國政，生母阿霍特普一度以攝政身分代理軍政，待他成年親政後，王室便用連續的北征替他的統治補上合法性。卡爾納克年表把每次出征刻在神廟牆上，記錄者是王室書記一系，文中多次提到王弟兼總理大臣賈胡提，以及王弟圖特摩斯先鋒開路，國王本人率中軍在後，交替以近衛弓兵與重裝矛兵壓住陣線的寬度。敵方是米坦尼的大王圖什拉塔，其父在他年少時去世，埃及一度在米坦尼另立幼主為傀儡，這段王位糾葛在後來出土的阿馬爾納書信與烏加里特書信中被反覆提及。大王陣中的地方強人包括阿穆魯的統治者、卡脫納王、卡爾凱美什王，以及不斷南下挑釁的赫梯王；後來阿門霍特普三世與阿肯那頓時期的書信，則把圖什拉塔抱怨金子短少、王子被扣的措辭完整保存下來。
peopleEn: The central figure was the young pharaoh Thutmose III. He had taken the throne in 1479 BC while still very young; at first the regent queen Hatshepsut ran the government, and his mother Ahhotep for a time acted as regent in military affairs, and once he came of age and took personal rule, the court repaired the legitimacy of his reign with a run of northern campaigns. The Karnak annals cut each expedition into the temple wall, drawn up by the royal scribes, and the text several times names the king's brother and vizier Djehuty, and the king's brother Thutmose opening the road in the vanguard, with the king himself following at the head of the central host. On the enemy side stood the Great King of Mitanni, Tushratta, whose father had died while he was still a boy; Egypt for a time installed another, younger, prince on the Mitanni throne as a puppet, and that tangled succession is referred to again and again in the Amarna and Ugarit correspondence unearthed later. Among the Great King's local strongmen were the ruler of Amurru, the king of Qatna, the king of Carchemish, and the Hittite king, whose provocations from the north kept growing. The letters of the reign of Amenhotep III and Akhenaten preserve in full the complaints of Tushratta about the shortage of gold and the detention of a prince.
kits: 任務單上那件埃及長矛是這場戰役真正吃勁的裝備：銅或青銅矛頭安在木杆上，握在步兵手裡，是大軍近身接戰的骨幹。埃及的近戰組合是長矛配圓盾，盾面覆皮、木胎蒙銅，長矛手排成密陣封住道路與城門缺口；真正提供火力的是複合弓與箭，埃及弓手自遠處壓制城牆與敵陣，長矛只在弓手掩護下推進到接戰距離才派上用場；另有月牙形短劍、長柄銅斧、投擲短棒，以及繫著長矛與弓套的戰車，車兵居高臨下破陣。攻城時要備好撞木、鐵鍬與槓桿，土壘築到城頭高度，缺口由工匠與工兵用鎬頭鑿開，最後由手持棍棒與短劍的士兵一湧而入。胡里與敘利亞聯軍的裝備較雜：短小型複合弓、輕便長矛與投槍、薄木盾，車兵數量少而湊。加上記役用的雪橇、驢隊、奧龍特斯河上的木船，以及後來在幼發拉底河以船隻搭成的浮橋，都是這場戰役能打遠的關鍵。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear named on the task sheet was the piece of equipment that did the real work in this campaign: a copper or bronze head fitted to a wooden shaft, gripped in the hands of the infantry, it was the backbone of close combat in a great army. The Egyptian close-order pairing was the spear with the round shield, the shield face covered in leather over a wooden core faced with copper, and the spearmen formed dense ranks that sealed the roads and the gaps in the city gates. The real punch of firepower came from the composite bow and its arrows: the Egyptian archers suppressed the walls and the enemy formations from a distance, and the spear only came into play once the foot had been pushed forward to contact under covering fire. Alongside them were the khopesh, the long-handled bronze axe, the throwing stick, and the war chariot with its spear and bow cases, whose crews broke formations from above. For sieges the Egyptians brought up battering rams, iron picks and levers, raised earthen ramps to the level of the battlements, and opened the walls with the pick of the engineers, after which soldiers armed with clubs and short swords poured through the breach. The equipment of the Hurrian and Syrian coalition was more mixed: short composite bows, light spears and javelins, thin wooden shields, and few or poor chariots. Add the sledges, donkey trains, wooden boats on the Orontes used for supply, and later the bridge of ships thrown across the Euphrates, and it is clear how a campaign of this reach was sustained.
tactics: 埃及的作戰有一套固定程序：孟斐斯與三角洲各行省徵集兵員，隊伍在邊境要塞察魯集結，糧秣由運載車隊與牛群沿途接應，然後取沿海大道經阿什克隆、卡美爾山隘與黎巴嫩山道北進，或走內陸沙漠路線並沿途掘井。國王行軍時間集中在埃及民用曆第四至第六個月，正是水位最低、可以通行與運作的季節。作戰上沿用埃及的城郊會戰法：先由國王在中軍前出展示陣容，把敵軍誘到城下開闢戰場，再以一部佯退引敵離開城牆，敵陣一旦拉開，預伏的步兵與弓手切斷回城道路，戰車自側翼衝擊分割敵軍，最後全軍壓上圍殲；敵人退回城內，就轉為圍城，用土壘與撞木攻破城門與城牆。奪城之後，年表會逐一記下繳獲的銅器、戰車與馬匹，並把當地統治者押回埃及另立新君。行軍途中埃及人沿途設驛站與蓄水池，牛群趕在隊伍兩側，遇敵時先鋒即展開盾牆，弓手上車再展開，以車隊掩護糧車通過隘口；圍城時則先在城外劃出營區，把攻城器械自河道運進來。
tacticsEn: Egyptian warfare followed a fixed procedure. Troops were mustered from Memphis and the provinces of the Delta, the columns assembled at the frontier fortress of Tjaru, rations were handed on along the line by baggage trains and herds of cattle, and the army then moved north on the coastal road by way of Ashkelon, the passes of Mount Carmel and the tracks over Mount Lebanon, or struck inland through the desert, sinking wells as it went. The king marched in the fourth to sixth months of the Egyptian civil year, the stretch when the water was lowest and the roads and river crossings were passable. In battle the Egyptians repeated their set-piece method for fighting outside a town: the king first showed himself at the head of the central host to draw the enemy out, a portion of the army then made a feigned retreat to pull the enemy away from its walls, and once the enemy line was stretched the waiting foot and bowmen cut the road back to the city, the chariots charged the flank to split the enemy, and the whole host closed in for the kill; when the enemy retreated inside the city the siege began, with ramparts and rams worked against the gates and walls. After a city fell, the annals itemise the copper taken, the chariots and the horses, and record the local ruler being dragged back to Egypt and replaced by a new one.
data: 關於兵力的數字，多半來自卡爾納克年表殘片：埃及人每次交戰都會刻下斬殺數，通常在數百至一千餘之間，被擄的戰車與馬匹以數百計，年表還記下繳獲的銅器、青銅器與金銀器數量。學界一般把圖特摩斯三世一次北征的總兵力估在數千至萬餘人，其中作戰兵種以步兵弓手為主，戰車以百輛計，配給的箭矢以數萬計；道路里程方面，從埃及邊境推到阿穆魯約五百至六百公里，來回加上圍城，軍隊在外半年的行程常超過一千公里。作戰時間集中在埃及民用曆第四至第六個月，也就是洪水退去、水位最低可以通行的季節。圍城耗時以月計，年表提到有的城被圍攻數月才打開，圍城期間的糧食主要由埃及與當地進貢供應。年表所記的戰俘常以數千計，送回埃及的俘虜被分派到王室農莊與工地；各城邦名冊上繳的貢賦中，青金石以塊計，銀器以件計，馬匹數十至數百匹，銅器數百件，馬匹多經陸路或海路運回埃及。
dataEn: The figures for strength come mostly from the fragments of the Karnak annals. After each engagement the Egyptians cut the number of the enemy slain into the wall; it usually runs from several hundred to something over a thousand. The chariots and horses captured are counted in the hundreds, and the annals also itemise copper vessels, bronze ware, and gold and silver taken as booty. Scholars generally estimate the total host Thutmose III took on a northern expedition at from several thousand to more than ten thousand men, with infantry archers forming the bulk of the fighting troops, chariots in the hundreds, and arrows issued by the tens of thousands. On distance, the march from the Egyptian frontier to Amurru ran to some five or six hundred kilometres, and with the return journey and the sieges the army commonly covered more than a thousand kilometres while abroad. The campaigning fell in the fourth to sixth months of the Egyptian civil year, the season when the flood has receded and the water is low enough for the roads and the crossings to be usable. Sieges were measured in months: the annals mention towns that had to be assaulted for months before they opened, and food during a blockade came chiefly from Egypt and from local tribute.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最深一層是舊秩序崩解後留下的真空：古巴比倫王國衰落，黎凡特沿海的商路與內陸的大王體系重新組合，圖特摩斯三世接手的是一份剛被重新劃分的遺產。第二層是米坦尼在胡里人手中迅速膨脹，向南吃掉阿穆魯與奧龍特斯河流域，把敘利亞各城收為附庸，直接頂到埃及在迦南的邊界；埃及若不奪回這條走廊，尼羅河的穀物、黎巴嫩的木料與地中海的商貨就沒有一條安全的外通道。第三層是赫梯自安納托利亞南下，敘利亞成了兩股勢力的磨刀石，米坦尼需要靠控制南方城邑換取赫梯的援助，埃及則要在援手到達前把局面定死。對年輕法老而言，北征同時是軍功與統治合法性的一課。此外，第二中間期之後埃及在黎凡特設行省、對前來朝覲的城邦收取貢賦的整套做法，都要求維持一條可控的邊境；一旦阿穆魯落入大王手中，朝覲隊伍就會在途中被攔下，貢賦的流水也就斷了。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason for the fighting. The deepest was the vacuum left by the collapse of an older order: the Old Babylonian kingdom had fallen away, the trade routes of the Levantine coast and the overlord system of the interior were being recombined, and Thutmose III inherited a legacy that had just been redrawn. The second was the rapid expansion of Mitanni under the Hurrians, which swallowed Amurru and the Orontes valley from the north, turned the Syrian cities into vassals and pushed right up to the Egyptian border in Canaan; without retaking that corridor the grain of the Nile, the timber of Lebanon and the goods of the Mediterranean would have had no safe outward road. The third was the Hittite drive south out of Anatolia, which turned Syria into the grindstone between two powers: Mitanni needed to hold the southern cities in order to buy Hittite support, and Egypt needed to settle the matter before that support arrived. For a young pharaoh the northern war was at the same time a lesson in military glory and in the legitimacy of his rule.
impact: 這場戰役的結果，要放到後來二十年的連續北征裡才看得出分量。埃及在阿穆魯與沿岸城邑建立了附庸體系，尼羅河的穀物與黎凡特的青金石、馬匹開始有條不紊地流進埃及；卡爾納克牆上留下的戰役浮雕與名單，成為後世唯一能核對這批戰事的原始紀錄，也把埃及的戰車與弓兵體系傳給了西亞與努比亞的盟友。另一面是壓力：埃及越深入敘利亞，越需要米坦尼與赫梯之間的矛盾為己所用，於是注意力轉向北方，間接鼓勵了赫梯的南下，終於在阿門霍特普三世與阿肯那頓時期釀成代理戰。阿馬爾納書信裡那些抱怨金子少了、王子被扣的書信，就是帝國在阿馬爾納時期崩解時留下的餘波。在裝備上，新王國前期的步兵仍以長矛與盾作為標準配備，雖然弓兵在實際戰鬥中承擔了更多火力，長矛仍決定了陣線的厚度；在制度上，阿穆魯的附庸君主與收貢文書往來，後來演成阿馬爾納時期設總督的辦法。
impactEn: The consequences of this campaign only become clear when it is set beside the twenty years of northern campaigns that followed. Egypt built a system of clientships over Amurru and the coastal cities, and the grain of the Nile began to flow into Egypt together with the lapis lazuli and horses of the Levant, in an orderly fashion. The reliefs and the lists cut on the Karnak walls remain the only original record by which these campaigns can be checked, and they carried the Egyptian chariot and archery system out to the allies of western Asia and Nubia. The other side of the ledger is pressure: the deeper Egypt pushed into Syria, the more it needed the quarrel between Mitanni and Hatti to work in its favour, so its attention turned northward and it indirectly encouraged the Hittite drive south, which in the reigns of Amenhotep III and Akhenaten grew into a war fought by proxy. The Amarna letters complaining of short supplies of gold and of a detained prince are the aftershock of the empire coming apart in the Amarna period.
result: 第六次敘利亞戰役以阿穆魯一線的屈服收場：埃及大軍打散聯軍在奧龍特斯河谷的部署，攻下幾座控制道路的城邑，把當地統治者押回埃及改立，敘利亞諸邦的貢賦名單從此寫進卡爾納克年表。米坦尼沒有被征服，它以大王的名號退守美索不達米亞，卻在前1449年前後與埃及議和，簽下最早一批以卡魯什圖為名的埃及與米坦尼條約，確認埃及在阿穆魯與黎凡特沿岸的宗主地位，同時承認米坦尼在兩河上游的現狀。這份和約沒有終結戰爭：往後仍有多次敘利亞戰役，赫梯的援軍也逐漸加入，只是此時主動權仍在埃及一方，而圖特摩斯三世的將軍們已把長矛、弓與戰車的配合練成一套可重複的戰役機器。年表對這一役的記載偏短，城名與擄獲數多已殘缺，只能靠前後役次與後世書信互相對照，大致可確定戰線落在奧龍特斯河谷到阿穆魯之間；雙方都沒有把這一役當成決戰，卻都在下一輪徵召裡先讓了守勢。
resultEn: The Sixth Syrian War ended with the Amurru line giving way. The Egyptian host broke up the coalition deployment in the Orontes valley, took several towns that commanded the roads, dragged the local rulers back to Egypt and installed others, and from that point the tribute lists of the Syrian states were written into the Karnak annals. Mitanni was not conquered: under the name of the Great King it withdrew to Mesopotamia, yet around 1449 BC it made terms with Egypt and signed some of the earliest Egyptian-Mitanni treaties, the ones associated with Kurustu, which confirmed Egyptian overlordship over Amurru and the Levantine coast while recognising Mitanni's position on the upper Euphrates. That settlement did not end the war: several more Syrian campaigns followed and the Hittite reinforcements came in one by one, but at this stage the initiative still lay with Egypt, and Thutmose III's officers had already turned the combination of spear, bow and chariot into a repeatable war machine.
